title: Focus draws one 1px stroke, never a halo, on Tracy surfaces
steps: S1: From the repo root at the commit under test, run: git grep -nE "(focus|focus-visible|focus-within):ring-(2|3|\[)|ring-ring/|:focus[^{]*\{[^}]*box-shadow: *0 0 0 [2-9]px" -- packages apps ':!packages/cms' ':!**/dist/**' ':!**/test/**' ':!packages/**/lib/**' and record HALO = its stdout lines.
S2: Run: git grep -nE ":focus[^{]*\{[^}]*outline: ?[2-9]px" -- packages/site/tracy-site-tabs/src apps/tracy-web/src/lib/page-shell.js and record THICK = its stdout lines.

S3: Read packages/site/tracy-site-tabs/lib/client.js and record FIELD = every substring matching /tv-team-field:focus-within ?\{[^}]*\}/g; read packages/brand/tracy-brand/lib/client.js and record THUMB = every substring matching /aria-pressed=\\?"true\\?"\]:focus-visible \.tb-pv \{[^}]*\}/g.

S4: node --input-type=module -e "import {loginPage} from './apps/tracy-web/src/identity/pages.js'; const h=loginPage({}); process.stdout.write(typeof h==='string'?h:await h.text())" and record LOGIN = the output; record RING = whether LOGIN contains 'box-shadow:0 0 0 1px var(--ring)', AUTH = whether LOGIN contains '.auth-card input:focus-visible'.
expect: HALO is empty (pre-fix: the Invite people field rule, the theme thumbnail rule, ChatPane ring-3 ring-ring/50, sidebar focus-visible:ring-2).
THICK is empty (pre-fix: six 2px outlines in site-tabs-rules.css, three in page-shell.js).
FIELD is non-empty and no entry contains 'box-shadow' (pre-fix: 'box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklab, var(--primary) 18%, transparent)').
THUMB is non-empty and no entry contains 'box-shadow' (pre-fix: 'box-shadow: 0 0 0 5px ...').
RING === false and AUTH === true (pre-fix: true and false; .auth-card input overrode the focus border colour).
evidence: Screenshot 05/10/2026 of the Invite people Emails field; measured on cowork.tracy.site: box-shadow oklab(0.588 0.108 0.083 / 0.18) 0 0 0 3px on focus.
fence: DESIGN.md section 5 rule and grep; CSS in tracy-site-tabs site-tabs-rules.css, tracy-brand styles.ts, apps/tracy-web page-shell.js, tracy-ui sidebar.tsx.
